Label the given diagonal \(P_1P_{14}\). It separates the remaining vertices into two sets:
- \(P_2,\dots,P_{13}\): 12 vertices
- \(P_{15},\dots,P_{20}\): 6 vertices

A remaining diagonal intersects \(P_1P_{14}\) in its interior exactly when it has one endpoint in each of these two sets.

So the number is

\[
12 \cdot 6 = 72.
\]

\[
\boxed{72}
\]
